mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months (as measured by the current value being lower than the value 3 months prior) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals a weak labor market that may lead to economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and INDPRO have increased by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 3.0%), the market reacts negatively to the policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) by at least 50,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased by at least 50,000 jobs over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 2000 thousand units signals a weak housing market that may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST falls below 2000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS not rising) signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL has risen by at least 0.5% and FEDFUNDS has not increased over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 118 signals an industrial contraction that may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 118, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
